title: 第9章 重生集团第10章 失败变种人
content_zh:
第9章重生集团
“这些家伙，没一个好东西。”
安德鲁双眼火光一闪，董事们的灵魂瞬间被地狱之火点燃。
这是复仇之灵的审判之眼。
“不要！”
所有董事齐齐惊恐痛苦的喊道，就在这时，火焰消失，董事们满身大汗的瘫倒在座位上，眼里满是恐惧，甚至连肌肉都在抽搐。
苏珊目瞪口呆，完全不明白为什么会这样——因为位置的关系，她看不到安德鲁眼里的火光。
安德鲁站起身，吩咐道：“霍华德，和他们签合约，以市价买下他们手上的集团股份，这些股份记在你和风魔他们名下。
另外，杜姆集团改名重生集团，具体手续，你来办，苏珊，准备接手公司，我不希望出现混乱。”
兼职律师霍华德点头道：“是，boss。”
苏珊有些迟疑地问道：“王先生，他们好像没答应卖股份？”
“答应，我什么都答应，我立刻签订合约，将股份无偿赠送给王先生。”
奈德惊恐的喊道，他现在只想离安德鲁越远越好，其他董事也是如此，他们心中充满恐惧，以后别说跟安德鲁作对，听到安德鲁·王这个名字，他们都会吓的全身发抖。
不仅如此，之前那一幕会一直折磨他们，伴随他们终生，除非，他们愿意弥补自己的过错。
“无偿赠送？说的我是土匪一样。”
安德鲁很是不满：“我不会抢劫你们，我会以市价购买你们手头上的股份，至于买股份的钱，你们无息贷款给我。”
霍华德吐槽：“这跟抢有什么区别？”
“文明人抢劫，怎么能叫抢？这叫正义制裁。”
安德鲁耸了耸肩，转身离开办公室——他约了《号角日报》的老板谈收购的事。
“想获得更多灵魂，我需要一个属于我的传媒集团，否则，民众们怎么知道真相？他们不知道真相，怎么会恐惧？不恐惧，怎么把灵魂卖给我？”

安德鲁暗暗想道：“不知道这个世界的蜘蛛侠是什么样的？托比蜘蛛侠？超凡蜘蛛侠？又或者，害死梅姨的圣母蜘蛛侠？”
……
在安德鲁与《号角日报》老板商谈收购价格的同时，有人正在讨论他，这很正常，毕竟，他一点都不懂得低调。
“安德鲁·王，大半个月前出现在赌城，连赌连赢，完全没有输过，各大赌场输给他的钱，至少上亿美金。”
一个头发稀少的白人朝电脑屏幕里的独眼光头黑人汇报道：“有不少人去找过他麻烦，但全都失踪不见，应该是已经遇害。
十多天前，杜姆集团的杜姆博士将股份赠送给安德鲁·王，另外，今天中午，杜姆集团的董事齐齐将股份以市场价卖给他。
我们怀疑此人是拥有催眠能力的异能者。”
“为什么是异能者，而不是变种人？”
神盾局局长尼克·弗瑞问道，提到变种人的时候，他的语气明显不太好，原因很简单，他掌控不了变种人，这就意味着，世界不安全。
“他在赌城呆过很多天，赌城是地狱火俱乐部的地盘，如果他是变种人，黑王肯定会派人招揽他。”
七级特工菲尔·科尔森说道，变种人三大势力，温和派x战警，极端派兄弟会，以及精英派地狱火俱乐部——这个世界，地狱火俱乐部还在。
content_en:
Chapter 9 Rebirth Group
"None of these guys are good."
Andrew's eyes flashed with fire, and the directors' souls were instantly ignited by the fire of hell.
This is the judging eye of the vengeful spirit.
"No!"
All the directors shouted in horror and pain. At this moment, the flames disappeared, and the directors collapsed on their seats covered in sweat, their eyes full of fear, and even their muscles were twitching.
Susan was stunned and didn't understand why this happened - she couldn't see the fire in Andrew's eyes because of her position.
Andrew stood up and ordered: "Howard, sign a contract with them and buy their group shares at the market price. These shares will be recorded in your and Feng Mo's names.
In addition, Doom Group has changed its name to Rebirth Group. You will handle the specific procedures. Susan, I am ready to take over the company. I don’t want to cause chaos. "
Part-time lawyer Howard nodded: "Yes, boss."
Susan asked hesitantly: "Mr. Wang, they don't seem to have agreed to sell the shares?"
"Promise, I agree to everything. I will sign the contract immediately and give the shares to Mr. Wang for free."
Ned shouted in horror. He just wanted to stay as far away from Andrew as possible. The other directors were also the same. They were filled with fear. Let alone going against Andrew in the future, they would tremble with fear when they heard the name Andrew Wang.
Not only that, the previous scene will torture them for the rest of their lives, unless they are willing to make up for their mistakes.
"Free gift? You think I'm a bandit."
Andrew was very dissatisfied: "I will not rob you. I will buy the shares you have at market price. As for the money to buy the shares, you will loan me interest-free."
Howard complained: "What's the difference between this and robbery?"
"How can civilized people call robbery robbery? This is called justice and punishment."
Andrew shrugged, turned and left the office - he made an appointment with the owner of the Daily Bugle to discuss the acquisition.
"If I want to get more souls, I need a media group that belongs to me. Otherwise, how will the people know the truth? If they don't know the truth, how can they be afraid? If they are not afraid, how can they sell their souls to me?"
Andrew secretly thought: "I wonder what the Spider-Man in this world is like? Toby Spider-Man? The Amazing Spider-Man? Or, the Virgin Spider-Man who killed Aunt May?"
…
While Andrew was discussing the purchase price with the boss of the Daily Bugle, someone was discussing him. This was normal. After all, he didn't know how to keep a low profile at all.
"Andrew Wang appeared in the casino more than half a month ago. He won consecutive bets and never lost at all. The money lost to him by major casinos was at least hundreds of millions of dollars."
A white man with thin hair reported to the one-eyed black man on the computer screen: "Many people have gone to find trouble with him, but they have all disappeared. They must have been killed.
More than ten days ago, Dr. Doom of Doom Group presented the shares to Andrew Wang. In addition, at noon today, the directors of Doum Group sold the shares to him at the market price.
We suspect that this person is a psychic with hypnotic abilities. "
"Why superpowers and not mutants?"
Nick Fury, director of S.H.I.E.L.D., asked. When he mentioned mutants, his tone was obviously not good. The reason is simple. He cannot control mutants, which means that the world is not safe.
"He has spent many days in the casino. The casino is the territory of the Hellfire Club. If he is a mutant, the Black King will definitely send someone to recruit him."
Seventh-level agent Phil Coulson said that the three major forces of mutants, the moderate X-Men, the extremist Brotherhood, and the elite Hellfire Club - in this world, the Hellfire Club is still there.
